title: A MySQL client config is served (/.my.cnf)
summary: The MySQL client config is downloadable, which commonly carries the database user and password in plain text.

confirm.control: A path that cannot exist, so the site's not found answer is known.
confirm.differential: status==200 and body_contains("[client]") and body_contains("password") and body_differs(control) and not body_contains("<html")

remediate: Remove the file from the web root and rotate the database credentials.
